component.name: OpenAstro Guider
component.summary: Headless Alpaca-only telescope guiding engine (PHD2 fork)

description.p: OpenAstro Guider is a Linux-only, headless guiding engine derived from the PHD2 telescope guiding software, reaching the guide camera, mount, and rotator exclusively over ASCOM Alpaca on the local network. It is driven remotely over PHD2's JSON-RPC event-server API — primarily by OpenAstro Ara — and pairs naturally with AlpacaBridge for network-based equipment access.

ul.li: Easy-to-use, “push here dummy” guiding for beginners
Sophisticated guiding and analysis tools for experienced users
Embedded web portal and headless mode
